candidate.engineering_resource_conditions: DARPA提供RACER车队车辆，配备世界级传感和计算能力；每辆RFV集成传感器和E-box组合，每小时收集4TB传感器数据；RFV由Carnegie Robotics LLC集成，基于Polaris RZR S4 1000 Turbo线控驱动平台；已完成四辆RFV，其中三辆于2021年11月交付；DARPA还收集了超过100TB的RFV传感器数据，来自中大西洋和西海岸超过500公里的地形。
candidate.excerpt_original: In November, the selected teams received the first of the DARPA-provided RACER Fleet Vehicles (RFVs) – a high performance all-terrain vehicle outfitted with world-class sensing and computational abilities – that they are using to develop platform-based autonomy for testing at upcoming DARPA-hosted field experiments.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 11月，入选团队收到了DARPA提供的首批RACER车队车辆（RFV）——一种配备世界级传感和计算能力的高性能全地形车——他们正利用这些车辆开发基于平台的自主性，以便在即将举行的DARPA主办实地实验中进行测试。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA RACER项目于2021年11月向入选团队交付了首批RFV车辆，用于开发平台自主性并测试。

candidate.engineering_resource_conditions: RFV机器人包括360度距离和图像传感，如多个激光雷达、立体相机对、彩色和红外成像相机、雷达、事件传感器和惯性测量传感；计算工具在环保、防震/防振、热管理的电子盒（E-Box）中配备多个一流图形处理单元（GPU）。
candidate.excerpt_original: RFV robots include 360o range and image sensing such as multiple LIDARs, stereo camera pairs, color and infrared imaging cameras, RADAR, event sensors, and inertial measurement sensing. Computation tools have multiple best-of-class graphical processing units (GPUs) in an environmentally protected, shock/vibration proof, and thermally managed Electronics Box (E-Box) that’s specifically engineered for the demands of the RACER high speed, off-road terrain expected in DARPA’s tests.
candidate.excerpt_zh: RFV机器人包括360度距离和图像传感，如多个激光雷达、立体相机对、彩色和红外成像相机、雷达、事件传感器和惯性测量传感。计算工具在环保、防震/防振、热管理的电子盒（E-Box）中配备多个一流图形处理单元（GPU），该电子盒专为DARPA测试中预期的RACER高速越野地形需求而设计。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA RACER项目的RFV机器人配备了360度传感套件和多个GPU的计算工具，封装在专为高速越野地形设计的E-Box中。

candidate.engineering_resource_conditions: 传感器和E-box组合目前每小时收集4TB传感器数据，以支持人工智能、机器学习自主算法和堆栈方法；每辆RFV包含防滚、传感器/E-box集成、自主控制和增加7kW功率的改装。
candidate.excerpt_original: The sensor and E-box combination currently collects four terabytes of sensor data per hour to support artificial intelligence, machine learning-based autonomy algorithms and stack approaches required of fast-paced combat maneuvers in complex terrain. Modifications for roll protection, sensor/E-box integration, autonomous control, and increased 7kW of power are included in each RFV.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 传感器和E-box组合目前每小时收集4TB传感器数据，以支持复杂地形中快节奏战斗机动所需的人工智能、机器学习自主算法和堆栈方法。每辆RFV包含防滚、传感器/E-box集成、自主控制和增加7kW功率的改装。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA RACER项目的RFV传感器和E-box组合每小时收集4TB数据，并包含防滚、集成和功率增加等改装。

candidate.engineering_resource_conditions: 已完成四辆RFV，其中三辆于2021年11月交付给RACER第一阶段执行者；预计在DARPA首次RACER主办实地实验前再建造四辆。
candidate.excerpt_original: Four RFVs have been completed, with three already delivered to RACER Phase 1 performers in November 2021. Four more are expected to be built prior to DARPA’s first RACER-hosted field experiment, scheduled for March of 2022 at the National Training Center in Ft. Irwin, California.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 已完成四辆RFV，其中三辆于2021年11月交付给RACER第一阶段执行者。预计在DARPA首次RACER主办实地实验（计划于2022年3月在加利福尼亚州欧文堡国家训练中心举行）前再建造四辆。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA RACER项目已完成四辆RFV，三辆已交付，计划在2022年3月首次实地实验前再建四辆。

candidate.excerpt_original: DARPA-hosted field experiments will provide the teams with a place to demonstrate the full capability of their autonomy stacks in complex environments. At Ft. Irwin, teams will demonstrate their ability to navigate courses with a variety of terrain and distances up to five kilometers.
candidate.excerpt_zh: DARPA主办的实地实验将为团队提供在复杂环境中展示其自主堆栈全部能力的地方。在欧文堡，团队将展示他们在各种地形和长达五公里距离的路线上的导航能力。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA RACER项目计划在欧文堡举行实地实验，团队将展示在复杂地形中长达五公里的导航能力。

candidate.engineering_resource_conditions: DARPA收集了超过100TB的RFV传感器数据，来自中大西洋和西海岸超过500公里的地形；这些数据在RACER开发工具中管理，与团队共享；还提供概念性政府基线堆栈和自主架构。
candidate.excerpt_original: To further support software development, DARPA has also collected over 100 terabytes of RFV-based sensor data from more than 500 kilometers of terrain in the Mid-Atlantic and West Coast. Shared with teams and managed within a RACER development tool for efficiency and security, this data will assist with learning approaches. Conceptual government baseline stacks and autonomy architectures will also be provided.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 为进一步支持软件开发，DARPA还从中大西洋和西海岸超过500公里的地形中收集了超过100TB的RFV传感器数据。这些数据与团队共享，并在RACER开发工具中管理以提高效率和安全性，将有助于学习方法。还将提供概念性政府基线堆栈和自主架构。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA RACER项目收集了超过100TB的RFV传感器数据，并计划提供概念性政府基线堆栈和自主架构。

candidate.engineering_resource_conditions: RACER项目授予两份合同，开发模拟环境和能力，以支持越野自主算法的开发。
candidate.excerpt_original: The RACER program also has awarded two contracts to develop simulation environments and capabilities to enable development of off-road autonomy algorithms.
candidate.excerpt_zh: RACER项目还授予了两份合同，开发模拟环境和能力，以支持越野自主算法的开发。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA RACER项目授予了两份合同，用于开发模拟环境以支持越野自主算法开发。

candidate.engineering_resource_conditions: RACER-SIM项目的两个主要承包商是Duality Robotics和Intel-Federal。
candidate.excerpt_original: The two primes for the RACER-SIM program are Duality Robotics and Intel-Federal.
candidate.excerpt_zh: RACER-SIM项目的两个主要承包商是Duality Robotics和Intel-Federal。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA RACER-SIM项目的两个主要承包商是Duality Robotics和Intel-Federal。

candidate.excerpt_original: Future RACER program activities include continuation into a RACER Phase 2 effort with a more representative 10T combat vehicle surrogate. The plan is to evolve in speed, scale, and mobility beyond the RFVs, as well as add a research track exploring tactics-based derivation of the new platforms.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 未来的RACER项目活动包括继续进入RACER第二阶段工作，使用更具代表性的10T战斗车辆替代品。计划是在速度、规模、机动性方面超越RFV，并增加一个研究轨道，探索基于战术的新平台衍生。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA RACER项目计划进入第二阶段，使用10T战斗车辆替代品，并增加战术研究轨道。

candidate.engineering_resource_conditions: DARPA提供具有通用性能、感知和计算能力的RACER车队车辆，用于评估表演者团队的自主软件。
candidate.excerpt_original: DARPA’s Robotic Autonomy in Complex Environments with Resiliency (RACER) program recently conducted its third experiment to assess the performance of off-road unmanned vehicles. These test runs, conducted March 12-27, included the first with completely uninhabited RACER Fleet Vehicles (RFVs), with a safety operator overseeing in a supporting chase vehicle.
candidate.excerpt_zh: DARPA的复杂环境弹性机器人自主（RACER）项目最近进行了第三次实验，以评估越野无人车辆的性能。这些测试运行于3月12日至27日进行，包括首次完全无人乘坐的RACER车队车辆（RFV），由一名安全操作员在支援的追逐车辆中监督。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA的RACER项目于2024年3月12日至27日进行了第三次实验，测试完全无人乘坐的越野车辆，并由安全操作员在追逐车辆中监督。

candidate.excerpt_original: The multiple courses were in the challenging and unforgiving terrain of the Mojave Desert at the U.S. Army’s National Training Center (NTC) in Ft. Irwin, California. As at the previous events, teams from Carnegie Mellon University, NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory, and the University of Washington participated. Additionally, researchers from the Army Research Laboratory demonstrated the flexibility of the performer team’s autonomy software, critical to transitioning RACER capabilites to the services. This completed the project’s first phase.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 多条路线位于加利福尼亚州欧文堡美国陆军国家训练中心（NTC）莫哈韦沙漠具有挑战性和严酷的地形中。与之前的活动一样，来自卡内基梅隆大学、美国国家航空航天局喷气推进实验室和华盛顿大学的团队参加了。此外，陆军研究实验室的研究人员展示了表演者团队自主软件的灵活性，这对将RACER能力过渡到各军种至关重要。这完成了项目的第一阶段。
candidate.normalized_claim: RACER项目第三次实验在加州欧文堡国家训练中心举行，完成了项目第一阶段，并展示了自主软件向军种过渡的灵活性。

candidate.excerpt_original: “At Experiment Three, we successfully demonstrated significant improvements in our off-road speeds while simultaneously reducing any interaction with the vehicle during test runs,” said Stuart Young , RACER program manager in DARPA’s Tactical Technology Office . “We were also honored to have representatives from the Army and Marine Corps at the experiment to facilitate transition of technologies developed in RACER to future service unmanned initiatives and concepts.”
candidate.excerpt_zh: “在第三次实验中，我们成功展示了越野速度的显著提高，同时减少了测试运行期间与车辆的交互，”DARPA战术技术办公室RACER项目经理Stuart Young说。“我们也很荣幸有陆军和海军陆战队的代表参加实验，以促进RACER开发的技术向未来军种无人计划和概念的过渡。”
candidate.normalized_claim: RACER项目第三次实验成功展示了越野速度的显著提高，同时减少了测试运行期间与车辆的交互。

candidate.excerpt_original: During the most recent experiment, teams completed more than 55 driverless runs of between roughly four and 11 miles each, reaching speeds of about 25 miles per hour. The performers completed 246 miles over 24.6 total hours on course with a robotic fleet of 12 RFVs.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 在最近的实验中，团队完成了超过55次无人驾驶运行，每次大约4到11英里，速度达到约每小时25英里。表演者使用12辆RFV机器人车队在赛道上完成了246英里，总时长24.6小时。
candidate.normalized_claim: RACER项目第三次实验中，团队完成了超过55次无人驾驶运行，总里程246英里，速度约25英里/小时。

candidate.excerpt_original: Last month’s experiment followed earlier experiments in March 2022 and September 2022 at NTC and at Camp Roberts, California, respectively. At those events, the teams tested their autonomous software stacks developed for the RACER program using DARPA-provided robot systems in a variety of environments, after development runs on their own in various locations across the U.S.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 上个月的实验是在2022年3月和2022年9月分别在NTC和加利福尼亚州罗伯茨营进行的早期实验之后进行的。在这些活动中，团队使用DARPA提供的机器人系统在各种环境中测试了为RACER项目开发的自主软件栈，此前他们曾在美国各地自行进行开发运行。
candidate.normalized_claim: RACER项目在2022年3月和9月分别进行了早期实验，测试了自主软件栈。

candidate.engineering_resource_conditions: DARPA提供具有通用性能、感知和计算能力的RACER车队车辆。
candidate.excerpt_original: “We provided the performers RACER fleet vehicles with common performance, sensing, and compute. This enables us to evaluate the performance of the performer team autonomy software in similar environments and compare it to human performance,” said Young.
candidate.excerpt_zh: “我们为表演者提供了具有通用性能、感知和计算能力的RACER车队车辆。这使我们能够在类似环境中评估表演者团队自主软件的性能，并将其与人类表现进行比较，”Young说。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA为RACER项目表演者提供了具有通用性能、感知和计算能力的车队车辆，以评估自主软件性能并与人类表现比较。

candidate.excerpt_original: Phase 2 will focus on maturing software stacks and testing autonomy over longer off-road courses with fewer interventions. The participating team or teams will port implementations of their autonomy solutions onto large-scale demonstration platforms, which will be representative of a combat-scale vehicle. They will also be required to increase speeds to twice that of the first phase performance metrics.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 第二阶段将专注于成熟软件栈，并在更长的越野路线上以更少的干预测试自主性。参与团队将把其自主解决方案的实施移植到大型演示平台上，该平台将代表战斗规模车辆。他们还将被要求将速度提高到第一阶段性能指标的两倍。
candidate.normalized_claim: RACER项目第二阶段计划将自主解决方案移植到战斗规模车辆平台，并将速度提高到第一阶段的两倍。

candidate.excerpt_original: Multiple factors limit the potential of modern autonomous systems (e.g., self-driving vehicles and uncrewed aircraft and watercraft).
candidate.excerpt_zh: 多种因素限制了现代自主系统（如自动驾驶车辆、无人飞行器和无人船艇）的潜力。
candidate.normalized_claim: 现代自主系统的潜力受到多种因素限制。

candidate.excerpt_original: Autonomy is learned through modeling and simulation, given the expense of training in the real world.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 由于在现实世界中训练成本高昂，自主性是通过建模和仿真来学习的。
candidate.normalized_claim: 由于现实世界训练成本高昂，自主性通过建模与仿真学习。

candidate.excerpt_original: A model of the intended platform requiring autonomy is created.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 创建需要自主性的目标平台模型。
candidate.normalized_claim: 创建需要自主性的目标平台模型。

candidate.excerpt_original: The model goes through various simulations in an environment as realistic as possible to generate the data that trains the autonomous system to make the right decisions.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 模型在尽可能真实的环境中经历各种仿真，以生成训练自主系统做出正确决策的数据。
candidate.normalized_claim: 模型在尽可能真实的环境中经历各种仿真，以生成训练自主系统做出正确决策的数据。

candidate.excerpt_original: After sufficiently training the model, those learnings are transferred to a physical system and tested to ensure the training works.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 在模型经过充分训练后，这些学习成果被转移到物理系统并进行测试，以确保训练有效。
candidate.normalized_claim: 模型充分训练后，学习成果转移到物理系统并测试。

candidate.excerpt_original: Training models in high-fidelity environments for Defense Department platforms can sometimes take months to even years.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 为国防部平台在高保真环境中训练模型有时可能需要数月甚至数年。
candidate.normalized_claim: 为国防部平台在高保真环境中训练模型可能需要数月甚至数年。

candidate.excerpt_original: Furthermore, autonomy becomes vulnerable when faced with unknown situations/observations in the real world.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 此外，自主性在现实世界中面对未知情况或观测时变得脆弱。
candidate.normalized_claim: 自主性在现实世界中面对未知情况或观测时变得脆弱。

candidate.excerpt_original: This brittleness is known as the simulation-to-real (sim-to-real) gap.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 这种脆弱性被称为仿真到现实（sim-to-real）差距。
candidate.normalized_claim: 这种脆弱性被称为仿真到现实（sim-to-real）差距。

candidate.excerpt_original: For example, a drone moving from a dense city to a coastal environment would encounter a dramatically different observation space.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 例如，无人机从密集城市移动到沿海环境会遇到截然不同的观测空间。
candidate.normalized_claim: 无人机从密集城市移动到沿海环境会遇到截然不同的观测空间。

candidate.excerpt_original: Unlike commercial autonomous systems, such as warehouse robotics or autonomous vehicles operating in a controlled environment using geofencing, military systems have far more unknown variables.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 与商业自主系统（如在受控环境中使用地理围栏的仓库机器人或自动驾驶车辆）不同，军事系统拥有多得多的未知变量。
candidate.normalized_claim: 与商业自主系统不同，军事系统拥有多得多的未知变量。

candidate.excerpt_original: For instance, flight dynamics could be off, the lighting conditions are likely to vary, and it’s often impossible to model an adversary precisely as they act in the real world.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 例如，飞行动力学可能不准，光照条件可能变化，而且通常无法精确模拟对手在现实世界中的行为。
candidate.normalized_claim: 飞行动力学可能不准，光照条件可能变化，且无法精确模拟对手在现实世界中的行为。

candidate.excerpt_original: Contrary to the conventional wisdom of high-fidelity simulation, DARPA experts theorize that learning and transferring autonomy across diverse, low-fidelity simulations leveraging their shared semantics (e.g., rules of engagement) instead can lead to a more rapid transfer of autonomy from simulation to reality – perhaps even as early as the same-day versus weeks/months with traditional approaches.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 与高保真仿真的传统观点相反，DARPA专家推测，利用共享语义（如交战规则）在各种低保真仿真中学习和迁移自主性，可以更快地将自主性从仿真迁移到现实——甚至可能当天完成，而传统方法需要数周或数月。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA专家推测，利用共享语义在各种低保真仿真中学习和迁移自主性，可以更快地将自主性从仿真迁移到现实。

candidate.excerpt_original: Moreover, moving from complex/realistic simulations to abstract and imprecise ones could allow systems to better adapt to the quick and inevitable changes in dynamic environments.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 此外，从复杂/逼真的仿真转向抽象和不精确的仿真，可以让系统更好地适应动态环境中快速且不可避免的变化。
candidate.normalized_claim: 从复杂/逼真的仿真转向抽象和不精确的仿真，可以让系统更好地适应动态环境中快速且不可避免的变化。

candidate.excerpt_original: The Transfer from Imprecise and Abstract Models to Autonomous Technologies program seeks proposals that put this theory to the test.
candidate.excerpt_zh: “从不精确和抽象模型到自主技术的迁移”项目寻求验证这一理论的提案。
candidate.normalized_claim: “从不精确和抽象模型到自主技术的迁移”项目寻求验证这一理论的提案。

candidate.excerpt_original: Modeling everything in high fidelity makes it so the AI agent overfits to the dynamics of the simulation,” said Dr. Alvaro Velasquez, DARPA’s program manager for the effort.
candidate.excerpt_zh: DARPA项目经理Alvaro Velasquez博士表示：“对所有内容进行高保真建模会使AI代理过度拟合仿真动态。”
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA项目经理Alvaro Velasquez博士表示，对所有内容进行高保真建模会使AI代理过度拟合仿真动态。

candidate.excerpt_original: “When you go to the real world, nothing looks exactly like what you modeled/simulated. We want generalizable autonomy across a variety of platforms and domains.”
candidate.excerpt_zh: “当你进入现实世界时，没有任何东西与你建模/仿真的完全一样。我们想要跨各种平台和领域的通用自主性。”
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA项目经理表示，现实世界与建模/仿真不完全一样，目标是跨各种平台和领域的通用自主性。

candidate.excerpt_original: Velasquez hypothesized that low-fidelity simulations would generate data at a much greater speed and scale, introducing the possibility of generalization rather than memorization.
candidate.excerpt_zh: Velasquez推测，低保真仿真将以更快的速度和规模生成数据，从而引入泛化而非记忆的可能性。
candidate.normalized_claim: Velasquez推测，低保真仿真将以更快的速度和规模生成数据，从而引入泛化而非记忆的可能性。

candidate.excerpt_original: Our vision is to learn autonomy over very diverse and abstract simulations,” said Velasquez.
candidate.excerpt_zh: Velasquez表示：“我们的愿景是在非常多样化和抽象的仿真中学习自主性。”
candidate.normalized_claim: Velasquez表示，愿景是在非常多样化和抽象的仿真中学习自主性。

candidate.excerpt_original: “We’re going to transfer that autonomy to our diversity of platforms and environments, and we’re going to explore the reverse direction.
candidate.excerpt_zh: “我们将把这种自主性迁移到多样化的平台和环境中，并探索相反的方向。”
candidate.normalized_claim: Velasquez表示，将把自主性迁移到多样化的平台和环境中，并探索相反的方向。

candidate.excerpt_original: Once we collect this real-world experience, we’ll explore how to refine our abstractions, models, simulations, and semantic representation to establish a feedback loop for more robust transfer learning.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 一旦收集到现实世界的经验，我们将探索如何改进抽象、模型、仿真和语义表示，以建立更稳健的迁移学习反馈循环。
candidate.normalized_claim: Velasquez表示，收集现实世界经验后，将探索改进抽象、模型、仿真和语义表示，以建立更稳健的迁移学习反馈循环。

candidate.excerpt_original: The program will feature sim-to-sim and sim-to-real competitions at the end of Phases 1 and 2, respectively, with the results of the first competition being used to down-select from six performers to three.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 该项目将在第一阶段和第二阶段结束时分别举办仿真到仿真和仿真到现实的竞赛，第一次竞赛的结果将用于从六家执行者中筛选出三家。
candidate.normalized_claim: 该项目将在第一阶段和第二阶段结束时分别举办仿真到仿真和仿真到现实的竞赛，第一次竞赛的结果将用于从六家执行者中筛选出三家。

candidate.excerpt_original: The program is organized into two phases.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 该项目分为两个阶段。
candidate.normalized_claim: 该项目分为两个阶段。

candidate.excerpt_original: Phase 1 is 18 months and will develop sim-to-sim autonomy transfer techniques and novel methods for automatically developing or refining low-fidelity models and simulations to be used for transfer.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 第一阶段为期18个月，将开发仿真到仿真的自主性迁移技术，以及自动开发或改进用于迁移的低保真模型和仿真的新方法。
candidate.normalized_claim: 第一阶段为期18个月，将开发仿真到仿真的自主性迁移技术，以及自动开发或改进用于迁移的低保真模型和仿真的新方法。

candidate.excerpt_original: Phase 2 is 18 months and will develop sim-to-real autonomy transfer techniques and novel methods for automatically developing or refining low-fidelity models and simulations to be used for transfer.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 第二阶段为期18个月，将开发仿真到现实的自主性迁移技术，以及自动开发或改进用于迁移的低保真模型和仿真的新方法。
candidate.normalized_claim: 第二阶段为期18个月，将开发仿真到现实的自主性迁移技术，以及自动开发或改进用于迁移的低保真模型和仿真的新方法。

candidate.excerpt_original: There will be two in-program competitions corresponding to the two phases of the program.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 项目内将有两场与项目两个阶段相对应的竞赛。
candidate.normalized_claim: 项目内将有两场与项目两个阶段相对应的竞赛。

candidate.excerpt_original: For technical details and abstract and proposal instructions, visit the program solicitation at SAM.gov: https://sam.gov/opp/0399474725314fd58f34bc29849ce305/view .
candidate.excerpt_zh: 有关技术细节以及摘要和提案说明，请访问SAM.gov上的项目招标书：https://sam.gov/opp/0399474725314fd58f34bc29849ce305/view。
candidate.normalized_claim: 项目招标书在SAM.gov上发布。

candidate.excerpt_original: Abstracts are due October 17, 2023, by noon ET.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 摘要截止日期为2023年10月17日美国东部时间中午。
candidate.normalized_claim: 摘要截止日期为2023年10月17日美国东部时间中午。

candidate.excerpt_original: While abstracts are strongly encouraged, they are not required to submit a proposal.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 虽然强烈鼓励提交摘要，但提交提案并不要求必须提供摘要。
candidate.normalized_claim: 提交提案不要求必须提供摘要。

candidate.excerpt_original: Proposals are due December 20, 2023, by noon ET.

candidate.engineering_resource_conditions: 参赛团队使用自主系统上的远距离传感器、机器人移动平台（如无人机和地面车辆）及算法，自主处理传感器数据并提供实时伤员识别和伤情评估。
candidate.excerpt_original: Teams used their stand-off sensors, robotic mobility platforms – such as unmanned aerial and ground vehicles – and algorithms, to autonomously process sensor data and provide real-time casualty identification and injury assessment.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 参赛团队使用远距离传感器、机器人移动平台（如无人机和地面车辆）及算法，自主处理传感器数据并提供实时伤员识别和伤情评估。
candidate.normalized_claim: 在DARPA分诊挑战赛系统竞赛中，参赛团队使用自主系统上的远距离传感器、机器人移动平台及算法，自主处理传感器数据并提供实时伤员识别和伤情评估。

candidate.excerpt_original: In the Systems competition of the first event, eleven teams representing multiple countries navigated three courses winding through a simulated airplane crash site, a convoy ambush, and a battlefield scenario in Perry, Georgia, September 28-October 4, 2024.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 在第一场赛事的系统竞赛中，代表多个国家的11支队伍于2024年9月28日至10月4日在佐治亚州佩里市，穿越了模拟飞机坠毁现场、车队伏击和战场场景的三条路线。
candidate.normalized_claim: 2024年9月28日至10月4日，DARPA分诊挑战赛系统竞赛在佐治亚州佩里市举行，11支队伍穿越了模拟飞机坠毁现场、车队伏击和战场场景的三条路线。

candidate.excerpt_original: The Virtual competition took place August 12- September 10, 2024, and the Data competition submission window was open from July 30- August 30, 2024, for teams to submit their solutions with results for all three competitions announced on October 5, 2024.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 虚拟竞赛于2024年8月12日至9月10日举行，数据竞赛提交窗口于2024年7月30日至8月30日开放，所有三项竞赛的结果于2024年10月5日公布。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA分诊挑战赛虚拟竞赛于2024年8月12日至9月10日举行，数据竞赛提交窗口于2024年7月30日至8月30日开放，所有三项竞赛结果于2024年10月5日公布。

candidate.excerpt_original: The ability to accurately and rapidly identify key physiological signatures of injury – such as hemorrhage and airway injuries – proved key to success in the DARPA Triage Challenge Event 1.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 准确快速识别关键损伤生理特征（如出血和气道损伤）的能力，被证明是DARPA分诊挑战赛第一场赛事成功的关键。
candidate.normalized_claim: 准确快速识别关键损伤生理特征（如出血和气道损伤）的能力，被证明是DARPA分诊挑战赛第一场赛事成功的关键。

candidate.excerpt_original: DART took the top spot in the Systems competition, while Coordinated Robotics topped the leaderboard in the Virtual competition and pulled off the win in the Data competition.
candidate.excerpt_zh: DART在系统竞赛中夺得第一名，而Coordinated Robotics在虚拟竞赛中位居榜首，并在数据竞赛中获胜。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA分诊挑战赛第一场赛事中，DART在系统竞赛中夺得第一名，Coordinated Robotics在虚拟竞赛中位居榜首并在数据竞赛中获胜。

candidate.excerpt_original: The self-funded Systems competition teams of Coordinated Robotics and UAS-DTU were awarded $120,000 for first place and $60,000 for second place, respectively.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 自筹资金的系统竞赛团队Coordinated Robotics和UAS-DTU分别获得第一名12万美元和第二名6万美元的奖金。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA分诊挑战赛系统竞赛中，自筹资金的Coordinated Robotics团队获得第一名12万美元奖金，UAS-DTU团队获得第二名6万美元奖金。

candidate.excerpt_original: The DARPA Triage Challenge aims to drive breakthrough innovations in identification of “signatures” of injury that will help medical responders perform scalable, timely, and accurate triage.
candidate.excerpt_zh: DARPA分诊挑战赛旨在推动识别损伤“特征”方面的突破性创新，以帮助医疗响应人员进行可扩展、及时和准确的分诊。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA分诊挑战赛旨在推动识别损伤“特征”方面的突破性创新，以帮助医疗响应人员进行可扩展、及时和准确的分诊。

candidate.excerpt_original: Of particular interest are mass casualty incidents, in both civilian and military settings, when medical resources are limited relative to the need.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 特别关注的是军民两种场景下的大规模伤亡事件，此时医疗资源相对于需求是有限的。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA分诊挑战赛特别关注军民两种场景下的大规模伤亡事件，此时医疗资源相对于需求是有限的。

candidate.excerpt_original: “Challenge Event 1 is the first in a series of challenge events that will be taking place over the next three years,” said Dr. Jean-Paul Chretien, program manager for the DARPA Triage Challenge.
candidate.excerpt_zh: DARPA分诊挑战赛项目经理Jean-Paul Chretien博士表示：“第一场挑战赛是未来三年将举行的一系列挑战赛中的第一场。”
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA分诊挑战赛项目经理Jean-Paul Chretien博士表示，第一场挑战赛是未来三年将举行的一系列挑战赛中的第一场。

candidate.excerpt_original: Only self-funded teams are eligible for prizes in the challenge events, but they must finish in the top five overall for the Systems competition and top five overall for the Virtual competition.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 只有自筹资金的团队才有资格在挑战赛事中获奖，但他们必须在系统竞赛中进入总排名前五，并在虚拟竞赛中进入总排名前五。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA分诊挑战赛规定，只有自筹资金的团队才有资格在挑战赛事中获奖，但他们必须在系统竞赛和虚拟竞赛中均进入总排名前五。
